name: vant-home
description: The vant.creadev.org SITE wire (web/home Pages Functions): the status API is the deploy's only runtime surface, so the site wire gets the same verdict discipline as the pod - typed unwired refusals, a fuzz floor on the summary GET, admin-door key/body discipline, and an honest cost cap that keeps one compromised key from becoming an edge-egress hammer. In-process handlers over a statement-mapped fake D1 - zero sockets.
